scope: Mean/total-conditioned retrospective reconstruction; this is not forecasting or independent-sensor validation.
expanded_feature_rule: The 13 primary features plus exactly their 13 corresponding '<feature>_missing' indicators. Missingness refers only to allowed coarse features, never fine targets.

feature_source_rules.own_current: Chosen variable's declared coarse track at t.
feature_source_rules.own_previous: Same coarse track at t-1h; intentional offline input.
feature_source_rules.own_next: Same coarse track at t+1h; intentional offline input.
feature_source_rules.current_variable_features: Only the four declared coarse variable values at t.
feature_source_rules.calendar_features: UTC midpoint of the coarse interval, computed from time_end_utc.

forbidden_primary_fields.T_CALC: Directly reports the final five-minute temperature target, not the hourly mean.
forbidden_primary_fields.T_MAX: Upstream hourly temperature maximum; outside mean-only input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.T_MIN: Upstream hourly temperature minimum; outside mean-only input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.SOLARAD_MAX: Upstream hourly radiation maximum; outside mean-only input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.SOLARAD_MIN: Upstream hourly radiation minimum; outside mean-only input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.SUR_TEMP_MAX: Upstream hourly surface-temperature maximum; outside input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.SUR_TEMP_MIN: Upstream hourly surface-temperature minimum; outside input policy.
forbidden_primary_fields.discrepancy_derived_minus_official: Cross-track target-related diagnostic; not a model input.
forbidden_primary_fields.complete_pair: Eligibility metadata; may filter samples, never a feature.
forbidden_primary_fields.valid_five_minute_count: Target-availability metadata; may filter samples, never a feature.
forbidden_primary_fields.constraint_class: Post-target diagnostic annotation; never a feature.

unknown_fields: Reject by default, even when a name is absent from the blacklist.
coarse_conditioning: A derived mean/total is intentionally made available by the task; it shares observations with targets and is not independent evidence. Official and derived tracks must remain identified.
eligibility_use: Fine validity, complete_pair and exclusion information may establish scoring eligibility only. Natural gaps have no observed ground truth and receive no error score.
extrema_semantics: T_MAX/T_MIN originate from upstream higher-frequency measurements; do not assert equality with extrema of twelve published five-minute means.
